dedupe_keys.name: microsoft and google building footprint area extractor

description: AsafBSh publishes the Buildings Footprint Extractor Python command-line script for selecting building polygons within a requested area from Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints and Google Open Buildings. The README describes separate source modes, chunking of large files, bounding-box filters, spatial indexing for Microsoft footprints and GeoJSON output. The public tree lists the main Python script, licence and an example tile index. It does not publish a new global footprint dataset; users obtain or process the source layers under those providers’ own terms. Repository metadata reports an MIT code licence, separate from any right to redistribute extracted polygons. The review read documentation and the file tree but did not execute the tool or test results for a location. Simulation use includes preparing local building nodes or hazard-exposure inputs for a defined study area. It complements data-google-open-buildings and data-microsoft-global-ml-building-footprints as a selection tool for their source data. The README does not establish error rates or guarantee coverage for any chosen city.
licence: MIT for extractor code; Google and Microsoft building data terms separate.
